Amelia at Stratix sent attached redlines and an account sheet. Please triage and advise next steps. I'm aiming for an internal quick-scan this afternoon, then we'll respond to Stratix with our first-pass redline within ~72 hours.

Triage checklist (please annotate in thread):
1) IP / license: any carveouts for model outputs? Are we comfortable with their proposed language in §6?
2) Indemnity & liability caps: confirm whether we need to hold firm on the standard cap and whether data-processing carveouts apply.
3) Data residency / KMS: Kimberly, sample language for customer-managed keys (hosted vs dedicated) and any operational constraints.
4) SLA & credits: confirm standard SLA credits cadence; flag any ask for higher SLOs.
5) Termination / transition: ensure order form outlines export of cached KV and customer data; propose transition assistance clause if needed.
6) Export controls & residency exhibits: if they request EU-only hosting, what are the additional obligations for us?
7) Billing/contact: Marissa, please verify PO onboarding steps and typical lead time for invoicing.

I've pasted Amelia's original note (above). Attachments: Stratix_Redlines_v1.docx, Stratix_Account_Info.xlsx

If Legal wants a short call with Stratix, I'll propose a 30-min slot tomorrow (Thu).

Thanks —
Karthik
